E_cross_phase_composition.method: A dedicated, independently-run investigation (fresh context, no reuse of any prior phase review) into 6 specific named interaction points between S1 (status vocabulary, navigation), S2 (guidance engine, dismissals), and S3 (importer flow, stale-calculation handling, tenant authorization).

findings.area: S1 status vocabulary <-> S3 declaration transitions
findings.verdict: GENUINE DEFECT, FIXED (this check's own commit be1c752)
findings.detail: S3's terminology-split commit (116b7c8) renamed the declaration approval transition's button/dialog to 'Approved for filing' but never touched its sibling error-message-mapping functions in app/(importer)/declarations/actions.ts, which still spoke the retired 'mark ready'/'marked READY' vocabulary for the identical transition in 4 reachable error strings (PERIOD_HAS_READY_DECLARATION, NOT_READY, POPULATION_CHANGED_SINCE_READY, APPROVED_POPULATION_UNKNOWN). Fixed in be1c752, verified via typecheck/full-suite/build/E2E, all green.

findings.verdict: MINOR ISSUE, NOT FIXED -- already disclosed and deliberate
findings.detail: src/domain/guidance/i19.ts's guidance-card title still reads 'Mark {shipment} ready' rather than the S3-renamed 'Ready for declaration'. This is real and user-observable, but was an explicit, disclosed, deliberate scope decision recorded verbatim in commit 116b7c8's own message ('Deliberately NOT touched: the S2 guidance engine's own title... reopening S2 for a cosmetic label match isn't warranted'). Not reopened here -- a known, accepted trade-off, not a defect this check discovered.

I19's guidance copy is carefully scoped to never claim filing-readiness or calculation currency -- only 'a resolved determination on every line' and, separately, 'eligible to be included when filed.' The real gate (LINE_NOT_CALCULATED/LINE_CALCULATION_STALE) lives correctly downstream in src/domain/declarations/completeness.ts and surfaces as named blockers at the actual filing-approval attempt. No false confidence is introduced by the guidance layer.

findings.area: S1 navigation <-> S3 new UI surfaces
findings.detail: S3 added no new routes -- all new components live inside the pre-existing /shipments and /shipments/[id] routes already covered by S1's nav-deriving logic.

Every S3 read path in app/(importer)/shipments/[id]/page.tsx (getShipmentDetail, getLatestCalculationsByShipment, listAvailableActualEmissionData, checkActualDeterminationStalenessByShipment, getDefaultReferenceForLine) receives org_id from the same single getCurrentOrgSummary call S1/S2 established. getShipmentEmissionsTotal takes no org_id because it performs no I/O of its own -- confirmed it is a pure aggregation over already org-scoped data.

Dismissal is a dashboard-only, per-guidance-item-id mechanism; S3's shipment-page readiness banner and emissions total are static page content with no guidance-item identity to dismiss. Different mechanisms by design, not an inconsistency.
